tbesh_html:
1) to tear, rend, pluck
1a) (Qal) to tear, rend
1b) (Niphal) to be torn in pieces
1c) (Poal) to be torn in pieces
1d) (Hiphil) to provide food

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: catch, [idiom] without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, [idiom] surely, tear (in pieces).
